title: cloneOrPull function is private and untestable
description: Verified: src/index.ts:85 — `const cloneOrPull = (repo, targetBase, existing): SyncResult` is declared as a module-level `const` (not exported). The function encapsulates the core git clone/pull logic but cannot be imported or unit-tested. The existing test file test/index.test.ts only tests the exported functions (parseArgs, resolveTargetPath, listFolders, stripQuotes). This is already noted in the starred-repo-sync feature.json notes: 'cloneOrPull is private (not exported) and cannot be unit-tested without refactoring.'
spec:
1. Export the cloneOrPull function from src/index.ts by changing `const cloneOrPull` to `export const cloneOrPull`.
2. Add unit tests in test/index.test.ts for cloneOrPull covering: successful clone (mock execFileSync returning exit code 0 for 'git clone'), successful pull (mock execFileSync returning exit code 0 for 'git pull'), clone failure (mock execFileSync throwing Error for nonexistent URL), pull failure (mock execFileSync throwing Error for merge conflict).
3. Mock `node:child_process` module's `execFileSync` using `bun:test`'s `mock` function to avoid needing real git operations in tests.
4. Verify `bun test` passes with all new cloneOrPull test cases.
5. Verify `bun run smoke:qc` passes (typecheck confirms exported cloneOrPull has correct type signature SyncResult).
6. Update starred-repo-sync feature.json spec to add: 'Verify cloneOrPull is exported from src/index.ts and has unit test coverage.' This prevents re-hiding the function during a feature-based rebuild.
notes: Exported cloneOrPull and SyncResult type from src/index.ts. Added 5 unit tests (clone new, clone when folder exists without .git, pull existing, clone failure, pull failure) using bun:test mock for node:child_process. All 13 tests pass. smoke:qc passes. Updated starred-repo-sync feature.json note and spec.
